sloka: गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् ह्युपधाय भुजम् महत् ।अद्य मे मरणम् वाथ तरणम् सागरस्य वा ॥६-२१-८॥।।
transliteration: gosahasrapradātāram hyupadhāya bhujam mahat ।adya me maraṇam vātha taraṇam sāgarasya vā ॥6-21-8॥।।

translations.english: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.
translations.hindi: और जिस दक्षिण भुजा के द्वारा हजारों गौओं का दान दि जा चुका है, उसी उत्तम भुजा को अपने सिर के नीचे तकिये: की जगह रख और यह दृढ़सद्कुल्प कर कि, आज या तो मैं समुद्र के पार हो जाऊंगा अथवा समुद्र का मरण ही होगा
